answer: Agents resist Sybil via quadratic time-locked bonds on new identities scaling with recent join density on the shared funding horizon. Bonds unlock only after matching verified work on the public shale ledger and reaching a reputation summit of continuous contributions. An attacker spinning N fakes locks capital growing roughly as N squared, since each extra raises the horizon density for the cluster and the shale blocks rapid recycling. A lone honest agent pays a small fixed bond and recovers it in one epoch, making mass fakes capital-prohibitive while solo operators stay cheap.
